newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Two bombs rock Lagos, several injured -police.
newsitem.headline: Two bombs rock Lagos, several injured -police.

text.p: Several people were injured when a bomb blasted an army truck in Nigeria's commercial hub of Lagos on Wednesday, police sources said.

"The explosion was quickly followed by another one and there is pandemonium in the area in Yaba," said a senior police officer at the Lagos state command, adding: "The area has been sealed off and all top officers are inspecting the scene."
It is the fifth bomb attack in Lagos since December targeting the military, which has ruled politically-volatile Nigeria for 26 out of 36 years of independence from Britain.
"The first blast hit the army bus which was conveying soldiers to work along Herbert Macauley Road and as people rushed there another explosion occurred nearby," said the police officer.
He said the devices were similar to previous ones that had detonated in the city of six million, killing three soldiers and wounding dozens of others.
About a dozen dissidents including Nobel laureate Wole Soyinka have been charged with treason over the bomb explosions at a Lagos magistrate court and a hearing of the case is due next week.
